title: Songs row player preload retry follow-ups from the #745 final review
acceptance: A failed row-player preload can actually recover in browsers that cache a failed module import (for example a cache-busted retry URL, or the record says why the cached failure is acceptable).
Leaving and re-entering Music › Songs after the preload gave up tries it again.
The loader and its retry live in one helper (in src/lib if it is pure), with a co-located test, so MusicWorkspace makes one call.
